home.text: Ringwise Receptionist: Sample tool (fictional). Answers calls you miss while you're on a job, takes the customer's details and texts them to you.

about.text: Ringwise Labs builds AI receptionist software for small businesses. Our office is at 12 Harbor Street, Baltimore, MD 21202. Dana Okafor is our founder and CEO.

contact.text: Email hello@ringwise.example or write to Ringwise Labs, 12 Harbor Street, Baltimore, MD 21202.
